product.ta-alphatronic-p2s.summary: The P2S doubled the P2’s disk capacity while keeping the same working memory.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2s.history: The P2S extended the Alphatronic P2 office range with double-sided drives. A May 1982 price list offered it for DM 7,950 before VAT, including the monitor.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2s.technical.con: Each disk could hold twice as much data as on the P2. It used two sides, with 40 tracks per side and 16 sectors of 256 bytes per track.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2s.technical.ver: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-p2s.technical.lim: The model-specific firmware and a boot disk remain to be preserved for verification.
